name: list_browser_targets
description: List page targets exposed by the selected loopback Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint. Optionally filter by exact origin. URLs preserve query values and fragments; only URL userinfo credentials are removed. HTTP discovery and browser-socket discovery use optional discovery_timeout_ms (default 10000 ms, range 1..2147483647, applied on the next call) without running a post-discovery target command, so this operation accepts no command_timeout_ms. An admitted browser-socket endpoint stays retained on the active browser provider for later calls and closes on unconfirmed target-session cleanup or when that provider closes; a discovery deadline or cancellation on a clean shared socket releases only that call's lease.
